entities.summary: Marco Pewal is an Austrian former professional ice hockey forward who last played with EC VSV of the Austrian Hockey League (EBEL). He participated at the 2011 IIHF World Championship as a member of the Austria men's national ice hockey team. He is currently an assistant coach in EC VSV junior youth program.
